props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after a pin, removal or clear.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when a row is opened.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Uncontrolled only: keep the list in localStorage under this key, so pins and removals survive a reload.

props.name: max
props.description: Most unpinned rows shown. Pinned rows are always shown.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level, so the list fits the page outline.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.defaultValue: 'Nothing opened yet. Items you view will show up here.'
props.description: Shown when there is nothing to list.
